mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing corporate profit visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and unemployment rate increase indicate monetary policy accommodation for labor weakness, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,100 thousand units signal robust consumer spending and business investment, accelerating earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1,100, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 indicates sustained manufacturing strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales below 400,000 million dollars signal housing sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS falls below 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate hiring and earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 235 and FEDFUNDS below 0.2% signal persistent inflation in a low-rate environment, triggering anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.
